description:
AGENTS.md is 80KB of accumulated conventions and is auto-loaded into every session, which makes it the highest-leverage stale document in the repo.

It still instructs agents about surfaces that no longer exist: the /live production mirror's parallel /servers, /cloud, /serverless and /projects indexes, "Add server" placement on the servers index, SSH and provisioning conventions, and per-product chrome rules for deleted product lines. An agent following it today will build against a platform that was removed on 2026-08-25.

Keep the conventions that still apply — styling, Livewire patterns, feature-flag layers, the billing model, shared header and footer components — and cut everything scoped to a deleted surface. AGENTS.original.md can be deleted or archived at the same time.
title: Rewrite AGENTS.md for the Edge-only shape
